verdict.rationale: Chronicle's agent registration records an agent's instructions, model, and tools so you can track changes between versions. You can then register new versions and compare them on the same task suites. That gives some first-party versioning of prompts, but it serves evaluation rather than serving or deploying prompts. The production monitoring with autonomous fix and rollback is a related feature and is not described as a prompt-deployment mechanism. Missing for 10: deploying prompt changes to production without a code release, prompt serving or fetching at runtime, environment promotion or labels for prompts, and independent corroboration.
